Explicit offline integration: tests/integration/run.sh; see tests/README.md for pinned workspaces, variant selection and fresh outputs
boot_centers: Complete-driver X/Y init regressions reject INT32_MIN; real-DTS guards require both named compile rejections and a valid signed-limit build on both cores. Before repair stationary input produces a maximum-axis step and both invalid DTS configurations compile. All previous runtime/motion assertions retained.
preserved_assertions: All math/motion/native assertions retained; equivalent node-lock checks replace stream-lock checks. DYA now owns pinned archive admission and actual registry/NVS reload fixtures.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.
suppression_extraction: Source KEY payload/sync stays unchanged; independent final filter owns button disposition and filtered-frame completion. Current ownership map: tests/README.md.
runtime_settings: Whole-source adapter and driver fixtures; real API/overdue-work cancellation, DYA registry and three NVS reboot pairs; tests/README.md
scheduled_work_settings_review: The bounded host FIFO and actual native input queue now force X admission / Y refusal. They verify retry-only-Y, no duplicate X, ordered completion and recovery across touch/layer/settings cancellation. The complete driver also tests synchronous callback reentry on either axis. X refusal now attempts no Y, so the existing failure case expects one warning/API attempt instead of two; all value/order and recovery assertions remain. The native fixture deliberately uses an eight-slot queue; this is API/kernel evidence, not physical HID congestion acceptance.
selected_workspace: Workspace selection uses tests/integration/workspace-env.sh to export the selected manifest's ZEPHYR_MODULES and explicit Zephyr package/base paths. A Zephyr symlink to a different cache must not select that cache's module providers. The owner test_workspace_env.py exercises actual selection with a poisoned ambient list, a cache symlink, module paths containing spaces, failed project discovery and an empty selection. The keep-ambient negative control must fail these assertions. Full integration retains all supported-core, role, persistence and invalid-DTS cases. No dependency is patched or required feature disabled.

integer_width.production: 32-bit arithmetic; independent wider oracles remain test-only
integer_width.contract: Coordinate offsets use checked 32-bit subtraction. Radial output distribution divides into whole and fractional parts before multiplication, preserving the existing bounds, signed remainder and report rounding without wide arithmetic.
integer_width.fixtures: runtime/math_harness.c retains radial direction/ramp, full-coordinate extremes, fractions, inversion and saturation. The whole-driver fixtures remain unchanged.

arithmetic_fast_paths.contract: The repeat worker calculates the radial distance once for its stored X/Y pair, then applies each axis's own deadzone, gain, limit, inversion and fraction. Live ABS events still use their most recent partner coordinate independently. tests/test_repeat_cost.py compiles the complete driver fixture with compiler function-entry instrumentation at O0/O2: exact asymmetric/reversed/zero/saturated pairs, stream selection, sync and one square-root entry per repeat. The old worker fails the count assertion. The canonical host entry includes it; this is an operation count, not a CPU-cycle or physical timing measurement.
